text:
sophie: Quick heads-up 1: I'm working on a docs PR to clarify Dedicated provisioning + autoscale behavior. Goals: 1) make SLA language precise around burst/preemption, 2) add minimal SDK snippets (JS + Python), 3) fix broken internal anchors and crosslinks, and 4) include a short migration note for renamed fields. Will open as a draft.

ben: I can do the JS snippet and a short console copy blurb. For SLA text we should prefer the term 'preemption' instead of 'eviction' everywhere. Also propose calling the config rename out in frontmatter: `migration: yes`.

michael: I'll handle the Python example and update the terraform snippet in the migration guide. Also, support asked us to recommend `isolation_level: strict` for regulated workloads and note that burst may be disabled in that mode.

dev-docs: Draft JS snippet (will include language tag):
```js
// set scale policy with concurrency + isolation
await client.dedicated.createScalePolicy({
  name: 'steady-throughput',
  max_concurrent_batches: 5, // was max_batches
  isolation_level: 'balanced' // balanced | strict | best-effort
});
```

michael: Python snippet I'll add:
```python
policy = {
  "name": "steady-throughput",
  "max_concurrent_batches": 5,
  "isolation_level": "balanced",
}
client.dedicated.create_scale_policy(policy)
```

ben: I'm going to update the SLA paragraph to: "Dedicated SLA applies to committed baseline capacity. Opportunistic burst capacity is best-effort and not covered by the baseline SLA; under strict isolation preemption may route traffic to pinned fallback models." Thoughts?

sophie: LGTM. Also link-bot flagged two anchors: provisioning.md -> `#capacity_isolation` (wrong underscore) and autoscale.md -> `#burst-behaviour` (uk spelling). Suggested fixes: `#capacity-isolation` and `#burst-behavior`.

link-bot: automated-link-checker: provisioning.md line 210 -> broken anchor `#capacity_isolation`. autoscale.md line 88 -> broken anchor `#burst-behaviour`.

michael: I'll patch anchors in the provisioning branch and add a short redirect note in /dedicated/overview so old links don't 404.

dev-docs: CI notes: preview build passed with warnings: code blocks need explicit language tags and migration rule requires `migration: yes` in frontmatter when renaming fields. Also linter warns about passive voice in SLA paragraph.

sophie: I'll push the draft PR after fixing language tags and adding frontmatter. PR link (draft): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/481. Please review snippets + SLA wording. Tagging @ben and @michael for final review.

ben: Will review today. If merged, we should update the Dedicated migration checklist and send a short note to support about wording changes (preemption vs eviction).

michael: I'll open a follow-up PR for terraform examples and console tooltip copy about burst credits.

ci-bot: preview build (branch): all checks green after fixes.

sophie: Thanks team 1: aim to merge before EOD so PMs can reference the updated docs in tomorrow's sync.
